steps.action: Inspect retrieve_v2.py synonym groups and required term coverage
steps.expected: At least required synonym families are present
steps.observed: 12 synonym groups present; all required families found (expenditures/outlays, receipts/revenue, defense/military, veterans/VA, social security/social insurance, deficit/shortfall, grants/grants-in-aid, debt/public debt, interest/net interest, medicare/health)

steps.action: Verify both channels apply synonym expansion
steps.expected: FTS and metric channels consume synonym-expanded inputs
steps.observed: _fts_channel_trace uses _expand_synonyms(...); metric channel uses _row_hint_variants(...) and synonym stages

steps.expected: 3+ progressive stages per channel with broadening
steps.observed: FTS includes exact_year_filter → exact_year_window → synonym_year_window/synonym_unrestricted → year_shifted/exact_unrestricted; metric includes primary_exact → synonym_exact → partial_match

steps.expected: Later stages run only when earlier stages are insufficient
steps.observed: test_fts_channel_trace_runs_full_progressive_cascade and test_metric_channel_trace_uses_partial_match_after_synonyms passed; skip-on-sufficient-hits tests also passed

steps.expected: Per-question strategy is visible in output
steps.observed: --test output includes per-question strategy via=... (e.g., fts:exact_year_filter, fts:synonym_year_window)

assertions.title: Prose/footnote retrieval integrated

steps.action: Inspect retrieval code for prose/footnote channel integration
steps.expected: retrieve() queries prose_fts/footnotes_fts and returns supplementary entries with metadata
steps.observed: _prose_footnote_channel exists and retrieve() appends entries with retrieval_channel='prose_footnote', file/page_id/content metadata

steps.action: Run uv run python retrieve_v2.py --test on 246 questions

assertions.issues: Contract requires non-zero prose/footnote contributions on --test; observed 0/246.

steps.expected: row_hint_alternatives read from data_requests and searched
steps.observed: _extract_hints includes row_hint_alternatives; retrieve() loops over alternatives and runs metric channel

steps.action: Inspect period-aware scoring function and rerank integration
steps.expected: Matching period gets positive delta; mismatched gets penalty
steps.observed: _period_aware_score_delta returns +0.5 for match and -0.3 for mismatch; retrieve() applies delta during reranking

steps.expected: Fiscal/calendar match and mismatch behavior validated
steps.observed: test_period_aware_score_fiscal_match, test_period_aware_score_fiscal_mismatch, test_period_aware_score_calendar_match, test_period_aware_score_calendar_mismatch, and fiscal ranking test passed

assertions.title: Retrieval recall improved

steps.expected: Recall@10 improves over baseline by >=2pp; no recall@K regresses by >1pp

steps.observed: Against retrieval_baseline_pre_improvement (@10=25.6), @10 regressed -4.1pp; @5/@20/@30 also regressed beyond 1pp threshold

assertions.issues: Recall-improvement contract not met on current repository state.

steps.observed: retrieve() aggregates hints from all data_requests and runs metric retrieval in a for h in hints loop

frictions.description: Validation contract mentions strategy visibility via --test with --verbose, but retrieve_v2.py CLI exposes only --test/--test-ledger; used per-question via= strategy output plus unit-test traces as equivalent evidence.
frictions.resolution: Captured strategy evidence from retrieve-v2 --test logs and passing progressive-strategy unit tests.

summary: Tested 8 retrieval assertions: 6 passed and 2 failed. Failures: VAL-RETR-003 (prose/footnote contributions reported 0/246) and VAL-RETR-006 (recall metrics regressed vs baseline thresholds).
